name: sr-cross-border
description: Suriname cross-border income tax for tax year 2026: who is resident, what Surinamese-source income a non-resident individual or company is taxed on (Wet Inkomstenbelasting 1922 arts. 1, 3, 26 to 30bis), the permanent establishment rules (183-day construction and similar work, insurers, surveys, the continental shelf, permanent representatives), the 15% deemed profit of foreign insurers, the 36% rate on non-resident bodies, the 25% dividend tax on dividends paid abroad and its 100/75 gross-up, wage tax for non-resident employees and artists (15%), interest and royalties paid abroad, relief for double tax only by treaty or staatsbesluit, and the two treaties in force with official texts: the Netherlands (1975, in force 13 April 1977; dividends 7.5%, 15% or 20%, interest 5% or 10%, royalties 5% or 10%) and Indonesia (2003, effective 1 January 2014; 15% caps), plus the 2024 Curacao treaty, signed and not yet in force. Trigger on: Suriname non-resident tax, buitenlandse belastingplichtige,
